An ordinary full-shelf Uninstall is permitted. The selected packed snapshot retains the same inner shelf ID, exact settings XML, and the three goods batches separately on the map.
The component stack inspection at the shelf lacks the ground deterioration line at this selected paused snapshot; this is not a long-duration decay measurement.
After ordinary reinstall at (112,0,132), the same 32 HP shelf retains its Critical settings, changes rotation from 2 to 3 and is refilled by the same three goods batches.

limitations: The unchanged baseline was inherited from an earlier furniture trial with developer preparation; this shelf trial itself uses ordinary UI actions with no save edits or code injection.

Resource totals include all retained physical container branches, including ancient cryptosleep occupant inventories. ComponentIndustrial total 40 is not 40 available colony components: the shelf stack has 30.
The packed snapshot is after tick advancement and ordinary hauling. Wood is already back at an older stockpile; it does not establish the exact immediate drop location or a single-step teleport.
Conservation applies to the observed stages and selected resources. This spacious map does not test blocked surroundings or a failed nearby placement.
These retained snapshots do not measure construction speed, uninstall speed, stack merging limits, per-tick deterioration, food rot or large-shelf capacity.
The saved reload is one game tick later, and root thing XML ordering changes. Cell membership comparisons are order-insensitive; exact shelf fields and original projection bytes remain checked.
